'''Kurt Schlichting''' published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs.

* [[Kurt Schlichting The Bith Deck]] (LS, April 1997)

He played in Fargo, North Dakota; before the [[2004 North Dakota State Championship]], [[Peter Jacobson]] and his Owatonna group came down on the Friday night, stayed at his house and playtested there.<ref name="pcf-5018-70672">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=70672#70672 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], thepityofmrt, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
